digest.component_or_area: review-bot service, LLM provider integration, Bedrock inference
propositions: The review-bot service must be reconfigured to route LLM calls through Bedrock inference profiles instead of the direct Anthropic API, using three separate model-class environment variables for frontier, standard, and trivial tiers to preserve the per-pass model split.

The review-bot Docker image must install the bedrock extra during the uv sync build step to ensure the pydantic_ai.providers.bedrock module is available at runtime, preventing a hard failure on the first Bedrock call.

A CloudWatch alarm must be created to monitor Bedrock InvokeModel client-error rate using AWS-native metrics, dimensioned by ModelId, with thresholds of >25% error rate over 15-minute periods to detect provider degradation.

The kill switch mechanism must be documented in the runbook to enable reverting the cutover by removing the three class-slot environment variables, restoring the built-in anthropic:claude-* defaults, with explicit statement that ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is deliberately retained for credential availability.

The cutover must not proceed until the safety net is proven: the voter-error alarm chain must transition from OK to ALARM on an induced VOTER_ERROR while the bot remains on the Anthropic path, and the Bedrock alarm must exist in CloudWatch with non-INSUFFICIENT_DATA state.
